text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having run through the Hopeful Stakes with 
grim determination, Admire Vega seeks 
further glory, setting her sights on the 
Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Encouraged by that display, Narita Top 
Road ran with fierce determination in the 
next day's race, putting on a spectacular 
performance to successfully secure 1st 
place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her classmates bloomed one after another, 
and suddenly, the entire generation began 
to stir with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To take on such formidable peers— training 
begins for the Satsuki Sho, the opening 
leg of the Classic Triple Crown.
